notes.note: Name of the DHCPv4 family on a scope: the tag in the scope list and on the scope page, and the group of codes in the option menu.
Name of the DHCPv6 family on a scope: the tag in the scope list and on the scope page, and the group of codes in the option menu.
Column header of the scope list: whether the scope serves DHCPv4 or DHCPv6.
Tab of a DHCPv6 scope with its DHCPv6 settings; only a scope on an IPv6 network has it.
The size of a very large pool (2^32 addresses or more), as a power of two rounded down; {bits} is the exponent.
Heading of the DHCPv6 tab; {network} is the IPv6 network of the scope.
Introduction on the DHCPv6 tab.

segment.source: These settings apply to the DHCPv6 clients of this scope (RFC 8415). The valid lifetime of an address is the lease time of the scope.
segment.target: Inställningarna gäller omfångets DHCPv6-klienter (RFC 8415). Adressens giltiga livslängd är omfångets lånetid.

notes.note: Label of the field for the preferred lifetime of an address, in seconds.
Help under the preferred lifetime field.

segment.source: How long a client prefers an address for new connections. Never above the valid lifetime.
segment.target: Hur länge en klient föredrar en adress för nya anslutningar. Aldrig över den giltiga livslängden.

notes.note: What an empty preferred lifetime means; {seconds} is the default in seconds as a formatted number, {valid} the valid lifetime (the scope's default lease time) as a duration.

segment.source: Empty: five eighths of the valid lifetime, {seconds} s for this scope's default lease time of {valid}.
segment.target: Tomt: fem åttondelar av den giltiga livslängden, {seconds} s för omfångets standardlånetid på {valid}.

notes.note: Label of the Rapid Commit switch (RFC 8415 section 18.3.1). Rapid Commit is the name of the DHCPv6 option.
Help under the Rapid Commit switch.

segment.source: A SOLICIT with Rapid Commit gets a committed REPLY at once, without ADVERTISE and REQUEST (RFC 8415 section 18.3.1).
segment.target: En SOLICIT med Rapid Commit får genast ett bekräftat REPLY, utan ADVERTISE och REQUEST (RFC 8415 avsnitt 18.3.1).

notes.note: Label of the field for the Interface-Id (option 18) that a relay sends for the link of the scope.
Help under the Interface-Id field.

segment.source: The Interface-Id (option 18, as text) that a relay sends for this link. A relayed request that carries it selects this scope before its link address does.
segment.target: Interface-Id (alternativ 18, som text) som ett relä skickar för den här länken. En vidarebefordrad förfrågan som bär det väljer det här omfånget före sin länkadress.

notes.note: Local check of the preferred lifetime: it is not a whole number of seconds.

segment.source: Enter a whole number of seconds, 1 or more, or leave the field empty.
segment.target: Ange ett helt antal sekunder, 1 eller fler, eller lämna fältet tomt.

notes.note: Local check of the preferred lifetime: it is above the valid lifetime; {valid} is the valid lifetime in seconds as a formatted number.

segment.source: The preferred lifetime cannot be above the valid lifetime of {valid} s.
segment.target: Den föredragna livslängden får inte vara över den giltiga livslängden på {valid} s.

notes.note: Local check of the Interface-Id: it is too long; {max} is the longest length in characters.

segment.source: The Interface-Id is at most {max} characters.

notes.note: Button that saves the DHCPv6 settings of the scope.
Button that drops the DHCPv6 settings of the scope so the defaults apply.
Toast after the DHCPv6 settings were saved; {network} is the IPv6 network of the scope.
Muted line where a DHCPv4-only part of the scope page would be for a DHCPv6 scope: the network boot tab, the admitted classes of the scope and of a pool.

segment.source: Classes, policies and network boot are DHCPv4 only; a DHCPv6 client is matched by its scope and its reservation.
segment.target: Klasser, principer och nätverksstart gäller bara DHCPv4; en DHCPv6-klient matchas på sitt omfång och sin reservation.

notes.note: Muted line in place of the server identifier field of a DHCPv6 scope. DUID is the DHCPv6 identifier of a server or client.

segment.source: The server identifier is a DHCPv4 option; a DHCPv6 server identifies itself with its DUID.
segment.target: Serveridentifieraren är ett DHCPv4-alternativ; en DHCPv6-server identifierar sig med sin DUID.

notes.note: Muted line under the lease times of a DHCPv6 scope.

segment.source: For a DHCPv6 scope the lease times are the valid lifetime of an address.
segment.target: I ett DHCPv6-omfång är lånetiderna adressens giltiga livslängd.

notes.note: Link from the lease note to the DHCPv6 tab.
Introduction on the options tab of a DHCPv6 scope.

segment.source: These DHCPv6 options go to every client of the scope and replace the same codes in the options of the server.
segment.target: Dessa DHCPv6-alternativ går till alla klienter i omfånget och ersätter samma koder i serverns alternativ.

notes.note: Muted line in place of the effective options view on the options tab of a DHCPv6 scope.

segment.source: The effective options of a client are shown for DHCPv4 only. A DHCPv6 client gets the options above merged with those of the server, per code.
segment.target: Klientens gällande alternativ visas bara för DHCPv4. En DHCPv6-klient får alternativen ovan sammanslagna med serverns, per kod.

notes.note: Local check of a DHCPv6 option code typed into the option set editor.
